supersedes_for_gate1: Only test implementation inputs; does NOT supersede locked Foundation rules or deployable config

decisions.canonical_world: one shared world, server authoritative for common effects
decisions.home_region: one selectable coarse region; 30-day switch interval is provisional
decisions.geographical_identity: immutable published Majakka node_uuid with source aliases
decisions.world_sites: real sourced safe places, plus clearly fictional published regional phenomena in coverage gaps
decisions.distance_engine: haversine and piecewise linear curve from Work section 04
decisions.field_rule: three different nodes and exactly all three committed links, no auto link, no passive area yield
decisions.field_roles: Beacon, Shelter, Lens; personal focus only, other players cannot overwrite
decisions.interference: Calm > Signal 24h > Active <=72h > Recovery 48h > Calm; max 20pp/event and 40pp combined; reversible with no permanent destruction
decisions.client_world: render, inspect and request; no authoritative wallet or graph modifications
decisions.gps: optional; map camera never changes action center; GPS economic benefits are unapproved
decisions.research: authored meaningful one-time alternatives; no button-spam repeatable surrogates
decisions.content: first pilot six distinct cases, minimum twelve genuinely distinct validated choices/challenges before public alpha

risk_gates.RG1: 8 L start -> exactly first local link costs 8 L; first empty-world field costs 18 L. Verify no forced session waiting or wallet deadlock.
risk_gates.RG2: A 6-day event may still create pressure although permanent assets are safe; compare with 30-hour option.
risk_gates.RG3: Remote node/link proof options are authored and costly; prove they are not renamed repetitive clicks.
risk_gates.RG4: GPS-optional player must have usable Lumen, not only one +4 claim per 20h; compare home-channel/collect alternatives at identical rolling cap.
risk_gates.RG5: 2 active fields versus 3 expedition roles must be tested for UX clarity; do not combine both models.
risk_gates.RG6: global server atomicity and multiaccount abuse not solved by mock tests.
